name: Local Invariant Summation
description: Replaced the global algebraic matrix equation $X^T A X = 2X^T X - 2$ with a local property requirement: each active node $u$ has a "stability" of $2 - c(u)$, and the sum of these stabilities must be exactly 2. This mathematically evaluates to $2|V| - 2|E| = 2$, which on an acyclic graph requires the induced subgraph to be a single connected component, but hides this topological requirement behind a localized arithmetic rule to break pattern matching.
